questions.question: Page Object Model Framework Setup
questions.answer:
Eclipse
File > Create New  > Maven > Maven Project >Select project name and location > Select an Archetype (Donot Select - 'Create a Simple skip archetype')>Select an Archetype > org.apache.maven.archetypes > maven-archetype-quickstart > Version 1.5
 Enter a group id for the artifact.

questions.question: Pre Requisites
questions.answer: After Creating a Maven Project, Check if all the mvn dependencties are getting downloaded or not. Else check  m2 Console in New Eclipse IDE for  Y: y acceptance, enter Y to install all maven dependencies.

questions.question: Packages
questions.answer:
Create base folders and resources

Under src/test/java, create packages:
tests

Under src/main/java, create packages:
framework.driver
framework.config
framework.utils
framework.pages

Under src/test/resources, create:
config/config.properties
apps/ (to store .apk / .ipa if needed)
testng.xml (suite file)
